header: A short form with MORE THAN ONE meaning at DSP. The glossary list (ExecutiveBriefing.tsx: DSP_ABBREVIATIONS) can hold one meaning per short form; this file holds the other meanings the same letters have, which only the circular's context can pick ("as per TA rules" is the travelling allowance, "the TA office" is the Township Administration). The second reading (edsVerify.ts) reads that context and may name one of THESE senses; a meaning that is neither spelled out in the circulars nor listed here is a guess, and is not shown. Shared by the engine (server) and the briefing component (client), so keep it free of imports.

doc: My rule: only senses I have confirmed go here (11 Nov 2026: TA; APO was already in the component).

symbols.name: isKnownSense
symbols.sig: export function isKnownSense(abbr: string, meaning: string): boolean
doc: True when `meaning` is one of the listed senses of `abbr` (spelling and punctuation aside).
